# BlackDrivo

> BlackDrivo is a premium chauffeur / black car service operating across New York, New Jersey, and nationwide in the United States.

## Services
- Airport transfers at 30+ major US airports (JFK, LGA, EWR, LAX, ORD, and more) — flight tracking included, complimentary wait time (60 min domestic / 90 min international), fixed pricing, meet & greet available.
- Chauffeur service (point-to-point rides) in 40+ US cities.
- City-to-city rides.
- Hourly and per-day chauffeur/vehicle rental packages for multi-stop trips and events.
- Corporate/business travel accounts with centralized billing.
- Limousine service.

## Pricing model
Fares are fixed at the time of booking based on route and vehicle class. There is no surge pricing — the price shown at booking is the price charged, regardless of traffic, weather, or demand.

## Fleet
Business-class sedans, first-class luxury sedans, and SUVs.

## Coverage
Primary markets: New York and New Jersey. Also available nationwide across the United States, including 30+ airports and 40+ cities for chauffeur service. BlackDrivo is also now available across Pakistan, covering Lahore, Karachi, and Islamabad (see https://www.blackdrivo.com/pk).

## Booking
Rides can be booked through the BlackDrivo website (blackdrivo.com) or the BlackDrivo mobile app (iOS and Android).
